_comment_en: Claude Code security hooks configuration. Copy to .claude/settings.json in your project.
_comment_zh: Claude Code 安全钩子配置。复制到项目中的 .claude/settings.json。

PreToolUse._comment_en: Block hardcoded secrets in file writes — checks for API keys, passwords, and tokens
PreToolUse._comment_zh: 阻止文件写入中的硬编码密钥 — 检查 API 密钥、密码和令牌

hooks.command: bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); echo "$INPUT" | grep -qiE "(api[_-]?key|secret[_-]?key|password|passwd|token|bearer|authorization)[\"\x27\s]*[:=][\s]*[\"\x27][A-Za-z0-9+/=_-]{8,}" && echo "BLOCK: Hardcoded secret detected in code. Use environment variables instead. / 阻止：检测到代码中的硬编码密钥。请改用环境变量。" && exit 1 || exit 0'

PreToolUse._comment_en: Block AWS access keys in code
PreToolUse._comment_zh: 阻止代码中的 AWS 访问密钥

hooks.command: bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); echo "$INPUT" | grep -qE "AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}" && echo "BLOCK: AWS Access Key detected. Use IAM roles or environment variables. / 阻止：检测到 AWS 访问密钥。请使用 IAM 角色或环境变量。" && exit 1 || exit 0'

bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); echo "$INPUT" | grep -qE "-----BEGIN (RSA |EC |DSA )?PRIVATE KEY-----" && echo "BLOCK: Private key detected in code. Use a secrets manager. / 阻止：检测到代码中的私钥。请使用密钥管理器。" && exit 1 || exit 0'

PreToolUse._comment_en: Block common insecure patterns — eval(), exec() with user input, innerHTML assignment
PreToolUse._comment_zh: 阻止常见不安全模式 — eval()、带用户输入的 exec()、innerHTML 赋值

hooks.command: bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); echo "$INPUT" | grep -qE "(eval\(|exec\(|dangerouslySetInnerHTML|document\.write\(|innerHTML\s*=)" && echo "WARN: Potentially unsafe code pattern detected. Review carefully. / 警告：检测到潜在不安全的代码模式。请仔细审查。" || exit 0'

PreToolUse._comment_zh: 阻止原始 SQL 字符串拼接

hooks.command: bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); echo "$INPUT" | grep -qiE "(SELECT|INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE|DROP).*\+.*\$|f\".*SELECT.*\{" && echo "WARN: Possible SQL injection via string concatenation. Use parameterized queries. / 警告：可能通过字符串拼接导致 SQL 注入。请使用参数化查询。" || exit 0'

PostToolUse._comment_en: Run security linter after file creation/modification
PostToolUse._comment_zh: 文件创建/修改后运行安全检查工具

hooks.command: bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | grep -oP "\"filePath\":\s*\"\K[^\"]+" || true); if [ -n "$FILE" ] && [ -f "$FILE" ]; then case "$FILE" in *.py) if command -v bandit &>/dev/null; then bandit -q "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo "Security issues found by bandit. / bandit 发现安全问题。"; fi;; *.js|*.ts) if command -v npx &>/dev/null; then npx --yes eslint-plugin-security --no-install 2>/dev/null || true; fi;; esac; fi; exit 0'

PostToolUse._comment_en: Check for .env files being created (should be in .gitignore)
PostToolUse._comment_zh: 检查是否创建了 .env 文件（应在 .gitignore 中）

hooks.command: bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | grep -oP "\"filePath\":\s*\"\K[^\"]+" || true); if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE "\.env($|\.)"; then echo "WARN: .env file created. Ensure it is in .gitignore and never committed. / 警告：已创建 .env 文件。请确保它在 .gitignore 中且永不提交。"; fi; exit 0'
